label: reported speech frame
explanation: This feature fires on the grammatical scaffolding of reported speech: the speech verb itself (especially "said" at sequence start) and the following function-word chain ("that", "he", "to", "the", "was", quotes) that introduces the quoted or indirect content. It is strongly triggered by a preceding "said" (58% of "said" occurrences are followed by a firing) and fires hardest when the speech verb is the first token of a sequence, with strength decaying across the next few words; weak firings on unrelated tokens are spillover noise, and it does not fire on the semantic content words of the speech itself.
